title: Indian Wedding Outfit for Tall Women: 2026 Guest Style Guide
excerpt: Indian wedding outfit ideas for tall women: floor-length Anarkalis, ankle-length kurtas, bold borders and proportion tips so your outfit never looks short.
body:
If you are tall, the best Indian wedding outfits are floor-length Anarkalis, ankle-length kurtas and wide palazzos that use your height instead of fighting it. Bold borders, big motifs and full dupattas all look in proportion on you. The one rule is length: make sure the hem and sleeves are actually long enough.

This guide is for women around 5'8" and taller, attending weddings in the UK, US, Canada, UAE or Australia, who often find ready-made Indian outfits stop short at the ankle and wrist.

*By the Bahe Kurtiz styling team, Jaipur. Every piece is stitched in our own Jaipur unit, and our block prints are printed by hand by our karigars.*

## What should tall women wear to an Indian wedding?

Tall women can carry volume, structure and drama that would overwhelm a shorter frame. That makes the floor-length Anarkali your best friend. It skims the body, flares generously, and the extra length creates the kind of entrance other guests notice.

The [sage green taffeta silk Anarkali with gota work and sequin organza dupatta](/products/sage-green-taffeta-silk-gota-work-anarkali-suit-set-with-sequin-organza-dupatta/) ($52) is a strong choice for an evening function. Taffeta silk holds its flare, and on a long frame it falls like a gown.

### The length check

On ready-made outfits, the problem for tall women is almost always length. An Anarkali that should touch the floor ends at the ankle, and sleeves stop above the wrist bone. Before you order anything, compare the garment length with your own height.

## Which silhouettes flatter tall women most?

### Floor-length Anarkali

The classic. Choose one with a waist seam at your natural waist, so the flare starts in proportion.

### Ankle-length straight kurta

A long, straight kurta with slim pants looks sleek and modern on a tall frame, especially for a reception.

### Kurta with wide palazzos

Wide palazzos can make shorter women look smaller, but on tall women they look effortless and elegant. The [sage teal hand block print cotton kurta palazzo set](/products/sage-teal-block-print-cotton-kurta-palazzo-set/) ($36) is a relaxed option for a mehndi or haldi.

> **From our Jaipur studio:** On a tall client, a bold border at the hem or a wide gota edge on the dupatta breaks up the length in a good way, so the outfit looks balanced rather than stretched. Chiffon and georgette fall long and soft, while taffeta gives width at the hem, which suits broad-shouldered tall women well.

### Proportion guide for tall women

| Element | What works | What to skip |
|---|---|---|
| Anarkali length | Touching the floor or the top of the foot | Ankle-skimming on a floor-length style |
| Kurta length | Mid-calf to ankle | Hip-length with slim pants (can look cropped) |
| Prints and motifs | Large motifs, bold bandhani, wide borders | Very tiny all-over prints |
| Dupatta | Full width, heavy border, draped both shoulders | Narrow stoles |

## How can tall women play with colour and print?

Your height means you can wear bigger patterns and stronger contrasts without being swamped. A few ideas:

- Contrast dupattas that break up the line, such as a gold organza dupatta over a deep green Anarkali
- Large bandhani dots or big floral prints
- Wide gota or embroidered borders at the hem
- A belt or a defined waist to add a horizontal line
- Statement jewellery: long earrings and layered necklaces sit well on a long neck

The [purple bandhani chiffon Anarkali with a hand-embroidered neckline](/products/purple-bandhani-chiffon-anarkali-suit-set/) ($52) is a lovely example. Bandhani dots spread across a long, flowing chiffon skirt look beautiful when you move.

For the sangeet or reception, the [lavender taffeta silk Anarkali with gota work and organza dupatta](/products/lavender-taffeta-silk-gota-work-anarkali-suit-set-with-organza-dupatta/) ($52) gives you volume and sheen at once.

This season, soft pastels with bold gota borders are a popular look for evening wedding guests, and they suit tall women especially well.

## Why is custom fit the easiest fix for tall women?

Most ready-made Indian wear simply is not long enough for tall women. With our [free custom fit](/custom-stitched-indian-suits-made-to-measure/), you share your bust, waist, hip and height, and we stitch the length to your body at no extra cost. That means an Anarkali that really reaches the floor, and a waist seam that sits where your waist is.

Shoes matter too. If you plan to wear heels, mention it when you order and measure your height in the shoes you will wear, so the hem lands correctly.

## Our pick for you

The sage green taffeta Anarkali for evening glamour, the purple bandhani chiffon Anarkali for a flowing daytime look, and the sage teal palazzo set for the mehndi.

A final etiquette note: tall women naturally stand out in photos, so keep your colour and embellishment a little softer than the bride's.

## Frequently asked questions

**What is the best Indian outfit for tall women?**
A floor-length Anarkali is the most flattering for most tall women. Ankle-length kurtas with wide palazzos are a great second option.

**Can tall women wear heels with an Anarkali?**
Yes. Just measure your height in those shoes when you order a custom piece, so the hem still reaches the floor.

**Can tall women wear short kurtis to a wedding?**
For relaxed daytime functions, yes, ideally with wide palazzos. For the main events, longer lengths look more balanced.

**How do I get an Anarkali long enough for my height?**
